originalFailure.retainedResult: Latest real batch remains 5/6; R1 5 requests, 0 registration/actions despite full source and reminder.

modelTask.draft: Same original resolveProductPlan/readiness validator; no parallel plan service.
modelTask.retrieve: One counted model request containing 1-3 typed queries. Existing reader bodies run within one serial tool deadline; nested work consumes original tool/read counters. No nested serial or permission round-trip.
modelTask.unsupported: Persist explanation/unchecked scope as interpretation, then original finishInspection unverified-scope in bounded program context after the queue resolves; zero extra model requests.
modelTask.malformed: No dispatch from invalid schema; incorrect citation/assumption gets original diagnostics; no-progress and original three-rejection limit bound repair.
modelTask.perResponse: Original offered-tool snapshot and one-decision guard plus SDK named choice. State changes cannot authorize a second decision or another unoffered tool in the same response.
modelTask.progress: Only exact newly returned character coverage or original plan/action/measurement facts; wording and decision records add no progress. Registration cannot borrow post-closure reminder/contract-repair scheduling.

actualCallCost.normalDraft: read -> draft: same two model requests as an immediate old read -> register; no added turn
actualCallCost.missingEvidence: one retrieve decision executes its queries now, then the next original counted request reviews the results; no separate permission request
actualCallCost.unsupported: one decide request, then no-model finish
actualCallCost.unknown: Real model tokens, latency, adoption and success rate not measured.

limitations: Free model replies are author-controlled; this proves scheduling/schema/validation, not live model adoption or improved real success.
Gap reasons and unsupported explanations are Agent interpretations. The program does not infer semantic completeness or necessary missing facts.
A model may still choose repeated gaps or invalid/text-only output; unchanged progress, request/time/action bounds end it partial.
Named tool/schema adds an explicit result form; semantic plan extraction, citation choice and necessary queries remain model work.
Only source registration is changed. No provider/model/reasoning/timeout, price/cost policy, R1/Jev/Figma, generic planning framework or acceptance scoring edits.
candidateConclusion: Implementation and necessary free validation complete; reviewable and eligible to freeze under original six-row/five-condition/eight-effect acceptance. No paid run is authorized by this engineering delivery.
